sources.title: Emo: Emoji suggestions on device | Desert Ant Labs
sources.snippet: Add Emo from Desert Ant Labs to this project. On-device emoji suggestion that reads a task, a message or a calendar entry and returns the emoji that fit, in 23 languages.

sources.title: Desert-Ant-Labs/emo - GitHub
sources.snippet: The model artifacts are published at desert-ant-labs/emo on Hugging Face. Each SDK pins the model revision to its own package version, and downloads are SHA-256 verified.

sources.title: Releases · Desert-Ant-Labs/emo · GitHub
sources.snippet: Emo.suggestions (for:) now accepts an optional skinTone to request a preferred skin tone for skin-tone-capable emoji. The model predicts the default (yellow) presentation; this is applied as post-processing.
